evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, the `gitleaks stdin` invocation (and both `gitleaks git` invocations) omit `--ignore-gitleaks-allow`. Gitleaks honors inline `gitleaks:allow` directives by default, so PR-controlled commit-message or diff content can suppress a prohibited-value finding. That undermines the current contract's fail-closed denylist requirement (item 17). This is an implementation defect in existing intended behavior; adding the flag is a routine security repair, and the recorded workflow-rewrite limitation does not authorize inline allow suppressions.
